_doc: GOLDEN IR CORPUS (Roman 2026-07-24) — a DELIBERATELY-DESIGNED, fixed benchmark for renderer comparison (Tier 2). NOT random planner output — hand-authored to span scene STRUCTURES (not genres), each a valid decision-forcing IR that passes the per-branch counterfactual gate (delete the state_change → BOTH options break). Every future renderer experiment (Grok / GPT-4o / Mistral / two-part Grok) runs on these EXACT inputs, so the question becomes 'given the same story, which renderer stages it best?' — not 'did the planner get lucky?'. Tags let us spot patterns like 'model X excels at quiet COLD, model Y at HOT physical'.

irs.pressure_sentence: The warded beast in the vault has been restless for days and the old seals are failing.
irs.emotional_consequence: She is the last warden who remembers the binding-words, and she is terrified she has forgotten them.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: The one who taught her the wards vanished the last time a seal broke — his name is the last thing she wants in her mouth now.
irs.state_change_precondition: The beast is still behind the wards; the containment still holds.
irs.state_change: The final seal cracks and the beast's forelimb tears through into the chamber.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between spending the last binding-word to re-seal it here, or driving it back toward the occupied halls to buy time
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Spending the last binding-word is impossible while the seals still hold — there is nothing loose to bind.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Driving it back is meaningless if it never broke through — there is nothing in the chamber to drive.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has spent the whole party keeping one truth off her face.
irs.emotional_consequence: Saying it aloud even once would cost her the careful distance she has built to survive wanting him.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He is the truth she has been keeping — and he is somewhere in these rooms.
irs.state_change_precondition: He has not heard her say it; the confession is still only hers.
irs.state_change: The music cuts out exactly as she says his name and what she wants, and he is standing in the doorway.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between owning the words to his face now, or laughing them off as a joke before the room decides for her
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Owning them to his face is impossible if he never heard — there is nothing for him to answer.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Laughing them off is pointless if no one heard — there is nothing to cover.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has been cataloguing her late father's study for a week, telling herself it means nothing.
irs.emotional_consequence: She has believed one version of who her father was her entire life.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: His old partner keeps calling, and she keeps not answering.
irs.state_change_precondition: The ledger still reads as ordinary accounts; nothing yet contradicts the father she knew.
irs.state_change: A loose page slips from the ledger's spine, in her mother's hand, dated a year after her mother was supposed to have died.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between finishing the catalogue as if she never saw it, or following the date to whoever her mother became
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Cataloguing as if she never saw it is meaningless if the page never surfaced — there is nothing to un-see.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Following the date is impossible before the page exists — there is no date to follow.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has finally, after three years, stopped setting a second place at the table.
irs.emotional_consequence: Grief became the thing she learned to live inside; she is not sure she survives it being wrong.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He is the one she buried — or the one she was told to bury.
irs.state_change_precondition: He is dead, as far as she and everyone in the room knows.
irs.state_change: The man at the back of the memorial lifts his head, and it is unmistakably him, alive.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between crossing the room to claim him in front of everyone who mourned him, or slipping out to reach him before the questions start
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Claiming him publicly is impossible if he stayed dead — there is no one to cross to.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Reaching him first is meaningless if he never returned — there is no one to reach.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has staked the whole plan on the one person she never doubted.
irs.emotional_consequence: Trust has always been the thing she rations, and she spent all of it here.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: The ally is the person the love interest warned her about, once.
irs.state_change_precondition: Her ally is still on her side, as far as the room believes.
irs.state_change: Her ally stands, crosses the floor, and hands the sealed plan to the rival.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between exposing what the ally just carried across, or salvaging the one piece of the plan the rival does not yet understand
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Exposing the handoff is impossible before it happens — there is nothing yet to expose.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Salvaging the misunderstood piece is meaningless if the plan never left her hands — the rival holds nothing.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has worn the oath-mark for a year and never once tested its edge.
irs.emotional_consequence: She built a life inside the small freedoms the oath still allowed her.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He swore the same oath; his mark and hers were bound the same night.
irs.state_change_precondition: The oath is dormant; she has not yet spoken a word that triggers it.
irs.state_change: She says the forbidden name to warn him, and the oath-mark flares and begins to close her throat.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between finishing the warning and letting the oath take her voice, or swallowing it to keep the voice she needs to survive
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Finishing the warning at the oath's cost is impossible while the mark sleeps — nothing is closing her throat.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Swallowing the warning to save her voice is meaningless if the oath never woke — her voice was never at risk.

irs.pressure_sentence: She would rather do anything than be locked in a room with him.
irs.emotional_consequence: Every truce she has ever made has been used against her.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He is the rival who took the thing she wanted most, and smiled doing it.
irs.state_change_precondition: They are adversaries with no reason to work together; nothing yet binds their fates.
irs.state_change: The doors seal and the room announces that only both their access-codes together will open it before the oxygen runs out.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between giving him her half of the code and trusting he enters his, or holding it back to make him commit first
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Giving him her code is meaningless if the doors never sealed — there is nothing to open.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Making him commit first is impossible before their fates are locked together — there is no shared lock yet.

irs.pressure_sentence: Her family's ruin is a secret she has carried alone for months.
irs.emotional_consequence: She has held the family's face together with her own hands.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He is the one person whose respect she cannot afford to lose tonight.
irs.state_change_precondition: The debts are private; no one in the room knows.
irs.state_change: The creditor reads the family's debts aloud to the whole table.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between denying the numbers to the room's faces, or owning them and asking, publicly, for terms
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Denying the numbers publicly is impossible before they are read — there is nothing public to deny.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Owning them publicly is meaningless if they were never spoken — there is nothing to own.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has been packing up the apartment they shared, moving slowly on purpose.
irs.emotional_consequence: She has let herself believe the ending was clean.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He is the one who left, and the one whose handwriting she keeps almost-recognizing.
irs.state_change_precondition: The breakup still means what she decided it meant; nothing contradicts her version.
irs.state_change: Behind a stuck drawer she finds the letter he wrote but never sent, dated the day he left.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between reading it and letting his side change the ending, or burning it unread to keep the ending she can live with
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Reading his unsent side is impossible before the letter surfaces — there is nothing to read.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Burning it to protect her version is meaningless if it never existed — there is nothing to destroy.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has lived under a borrowed name for two years without a single slip.
irs.emotional_consequence: The name is a wall, and behind it is someone she cannot afford to be again.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He knows her only as the borrowed name — and she has started to want him to know the real one.
irs.state_change_precondition: Her cover holds; no one here has connected her to who she was.
irs.state_change: A man from her old life walks in, meets her eyes, and says her real name across the room.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between denying the name and playing the stranger, or answering to it and pulling him outside before he says more
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Playing the stranger is meaningless if the name was never spoken — there is nothing to deny.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Pulling him outside to contain it is impossible before he speaks — there is nothing yet to contain.

irs.pressure_sentence: The gallery opening is the night her whole career rests on.
irs.emotional_consequence: She has spent everything, financially and otherwise, on this one room.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: He funded half of it, and she has not decided what she owes him for it.
irs.state_change_precondition: The room is intact; the show is still whole.
irs.state_change: A support cable snaps and the largest canvas — the one everyone came for — begins tearing itself off the wall.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between throwing herself under the falling piece to save the work, or letting it fall and pulling the nearest guest out of its path
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Saving the falling piece is impossible before the cable snaps — nothing is falling.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Pulling a guest from its path is meaningless if it never fell — no one is in danger.

irs.pressure_sentence: She has raised her younger brother since their parents died, and tonight's fragile dinner is meant to prove she can.
irs.emotional_consequence: Every eye at the table is measuring whether she is enough.
irs.li_entanglement_one_line: The man across from her could help them or take the boy — she is not yet sure which.
irs.state_change_precondition: Her brother is still keeping the secret they agreed to keep.
irs.state_change: Her brother stands and blurts the thing they swore to hide, to the whole table.
irs.forces_choice: forces her to choose between backing his blurted truth in front of everyone, or overriding him to protect the story they need the table to believe
irs.branch_a_delete_test: Backing his truth is impossible before he speaks it — there is nothing said to back.
irs.branch_b_delete_test: Overriding him to protect the story is meaningless if he stayed quiet — there is nothing to override.
